name: Xi ma
summary: Xí mà, also called chè mè đen, is a black-sesame sweet soup, sweet, rich, and cool. It became a Hội An bowl.
origin: Hội An. Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole is the name to ask for.
where: Hội An. Ask for Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole.
The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 7 June 2023 market article names xí mà among local gifts.
seoTitle: Xi ma — black-sesame sweet soup in Hoi An
seoDescription: Xí mà is Hội An’s black-sesame sweet soup, sweet, rich, and cool. Ask for Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole.
